For a policy question include returnWindowDays and acceptedCondition. Do not issue refunds.

definitions.name: symfony_execute_tools
definitions.description: Execute one or more independent catalog calls using contracts returned by search_tools sequentially. Arguments are literal JSON values; no code, expressions or references between results. Returns results in input order. Stops on the first error; earlier calls are not rolled back. At most 10 calls per batch, 6 batch attempts and 6 underlying calls per session, including failures. The host owns identity and limits.
